directedQuint.testSource:
module slop_session_lost_create {
  import contributor__sessionExchange as E from "./contributor__sessionExchange"
  var state: E::Exchange
  action init = state' = E::initial
  action begin = state' = E::begin(state, 1, "payload-digest")
  action start = state' = E::acceptStart(state, 7, 2)
  action show = state' = E::receiveStart(state, 1, true)
  action authorize = state' = E::authorizeFlow(state, "immutable-github-id")
  action waitPoll = state' = E::waitPoll(state)
  action poll = state' = E::acceptPoll(state, 6)
  action assertion = state' = E::receivePoll(state, 1, 2, true)
  action exchange = state' = E::exchange(state, 8, true, true)
  action receive = state' = E::receiveBearer(state, 1, true)
  action access = state' = E::authenticateCreate(state, true)
  action commit = state' = E::commitCreate(state, { serverId: "existing-run", status: E::Finalized }, true)
  action lose = state' = E::receiveCreate(state, 1, false)
  run lostWriteReplyTest = init.then(begin).then(start).then(show).then(authorize)
    .then(waitPoll).then(poll).then(assertion).then(exchange).then(receive).then(access)
    .then(commit).then(lose).expect(E::sometimesLostButCommitted(state) and state.snapshot.serverId == "existing-run")
}
